title: The base change map of the structure sheaf is a morphism of algebras
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$, $g:S'\to S$, $g':X'\to X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $f\circ g'=g\circ f'$, let $g^*\dashv g_*$ etc. be the pullback and pushforward of modules [def-pc-module-pullback] with units $\eta$, and let $\otimes$ be the tensor product of modules [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $\mathcal A=f_*\mathcal O_X$ and $\mathcal A'=f'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$ with their algebra structures (sections $\mathcal O_X(f^{-1}W)$, multiplications $\mu:\mathcal A\otimes\mathcal A\to\mathcal A$, $\mu'$, units $f^\sharp:\mathcal O_S\to\mathcal A$, $f'^\sharp:\mathcal O_{S'}\to\mathcal A'$). Give $g^*\mathcal A$ the multiplication $g^*(\mu)\circ t^{-1}:g^*\mathcal A\otimes g^*\mathcal A\to g^*\mathcal A$, with $t:g^*(\mathcal A\otimes\mathcal A)\cong g^*\mathcal A\otimes g^*\mathcal A$ the isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor], and the unit $g^*(f^\sharp)\circ\epsilon_g^{-1}:\mathcal O_{S'}\to g^*\mathcal A$, with $\epsilon_g:g^*\mathcal O_S\cong\mathcal O_{S'}$ and $\epsilon_{g'}:g'^*\mathcal O_X\cong\mathcal O_{X'}$ the isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf]. Let $\beta:g^*\mathcal A\to f'_*g'^*\mathcal O_X$ be the base change map, i.e. the morphism corresponding under $g^*\dashv g_*$ to $f_*(\eta_{g',\mathcal O_X}):f_*\mathcal O_X\to f_*g'_*g'^*\mathcal O_X=g_*f'_*g'^*\mathcal O_X$, and $\gamma=f'_*(\epsilon_{g'})\circ\beta:g^*\mathcal A\to\mathcal A'$. Then (i) $\gamma$ is the morphism corresponding under $g^*\dashv g_*$ to $f_*(g'^\sharp):\mathcal A\to g_*\mathcal A'$, i.e. $\gamma(\eta_g(a))=g'^\sharp(a)\in\mathcal O_{X'}(f'^{-1}g^{-1}W)$ for $a\in\mathcal A(W)=\mathcal O_X(f^{-1}W)$; (ii) $\gamma\circ g^*(\mu)=\mu'\circ(\gamma\otimes\gamma)\circ t$ and $\gamma\circ g^*(f^\sharp)=f'^\sharp\circ\epsilon_g$, i.e. $\gamma$ is a morphism of $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebras. (No hypothesis on $f$ or on the square beyond commutativity.)
